description: Type objects.delete's and objects.patch's HTTP 412 when an ifGenerationMatch / ifMetagenerationMatch precondition does not hold ('At least one of the pre-conditions you specified did not hold.'). 412 is not in the core status map, so it landed as UnknownGCPError. Compare-and-swap callers (alchemy's GCS state-store lock) need to tell a lost race from a real failure.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The object's live generation or metageneration does not match the request's ifGenerationMatch / ifMetagenerationMatch precondition (HTTP 412). Another writer changed or replaced the object.
